PRIMARY_ARCHITECTURE.rule: all four may be absent while pending; if any is supplied all four are required

EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.rule: both may be absent while pending; if either is supplied both are required

PREDICTOR_REVIEW.rule: both may be absent while pending; if either is supplied both are required

intake_order: accept any one or more complete human-return stages
reject partial files within each stage
validate each supplied single-coder return against frozen lane identity and group set
merge supplied architecture coder stages into canonical lane ledgers
compute agreement and exact disagreements for each supplied architecture lane
when supplied, validate U2/U6 predictor adjudication returns against frozen receipt frames
write deterministic intake workspace only after every supplied stage validates
prohibitions: do not make U1 external-validation latency block U2/U6 primary reliability
do not make architecture-return latency block predictor-return validation
do not make predictor-review latency block architecture reliability reporting
do not silently fall back to tracked blank worksheets when a supplied stage is incomplete
do not accept a partial file set within any declared return stage
do not adjudicate architecture disagreements inside intake
do not synthesize rejected predictor receipts
do not set ready_for_v4_assembly=true at intake stage
do not overwrite an existing intake workspace

predictor_return_pair.rule: both may be absent while pending; if either is supplied both are required
